### 3. actionlint-local-only-no-ci-gate

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | deepen |
| Diagnosis | DECISION: actionlint IS a merge gate (correct fix; dropping it from `just ci` is the cheap fix). Evidence: (1) `justfile:83` `ci:` lists `verify-actionlint` under the comment 'Local equivalent of the required pull-request pipeline', but `.github/workflows/ci.yml` has no actionlint step (only `verify-ai-docs` at `ci.yml:115-117`, `verify-changed-format` at `ci.yml:150-152`, `verify-nuget-audit` at `ci.yml:160-162`); a workflow-syntax regression merges green. (2) `ActionlintGateContractTests.JustfileAndCiPolicy_WireTheActionlintGateIntoRequiredValidation` (`tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/ActionlintGateContractTests.cs:34-57`) already asserts the gate is 'required validation' but only checks justfile + `CI_POLICY.md`, never `ci.yml` - the contract is half-wired. (3) Provisioning is not a blocker: `eng/verify-actionlint.ps1` is self-provisioning and checksum-pinned (v1.7.12, per-RID archive+binary SHA-256, includes `linux-x64`); it downloads from GitHub releases on ubuntu-latest, hashes before extract, fails closed; the artifact-owner leg is hosted Linux (`ci.yml:107-108`), so no operator decision is needed. (4) Docs-only clause in the acceptance is moot: `eng/resolve-ci-topology.ps1:98` classifies only `*.md` and `ai_docs/*.json` as docs, so a PR touching `.github/workflows/*.yml` is always a code PR (docs_only=false); an unconditional artifact-owner step therefore covers every workflow-touching PR. Run it unconditionally on the artifact-owner leg (cheap, ~1 binary run) rather than path-filtering.  | 
| Approach | (a) `ci.yml`: add step 'Lint GitHub Actions workflows' (`shell: pwsh`, `run: ./eng/verify-actionlint.ps1`, `if: matrix.leg.artifact_owner == true`) immediately after 'Validate AI docs' (`ci.yml:114-117`), before .NET setup - mirror that step's shape. (b) `ActionlintGateContractTests.cs`: extend the wiring test to read `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and assert it contains `./eng/verify-actionlint.ps1` and that the step is artifact-owner gated (mirror `NuGetAuditGateTests.cs:32`). (c) `ai_docs/prompts/backlog-sweep-addenda.md`: add `verify-actionlint` to the machine-readable `ci_equivalent` list in order and delete the 'local-only `verify-actionlint`' clause from the `just ci` note (line 35) since it is now a PR-leg gate. (d) `CI_POLICY.md:134`/Local Validation table: keep wording, add that the same script runs on the hosted artifact-owner leg. |
| Scope | 3 production files (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `ai_docs/prompts/backlog-sweep-addenda.md`, `CI_POLICY.md`) + 1 test file (`tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/ActionlintGateContractTests.cs`). Within Rule 3 target; one coherent change (make the declared gate real and lock it). |

### 4. docs-only-route-runs-full-test-suite

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | deepen |
| Diagnosis | `.github/workflows/ci.yml:143-145` sets `TestShardOnly = $true` on the docs-only route, but `eng/verify-release.ps1` only uses that switch to skip packaging/publish work (`if (-not $TestShardOnly)` at :439). The test run is unconditional: `eng/verify-release.ps1:365` prepends the shard `SelectedFilter` from `get-test-shard-plan.ps1` to the `TestCategory!=Benchmark` base filter and `:428` runs `dotnet test` with it. Nothing carries the docs-only signal into class selection, so a backlog-only edit runs every class in its shard. |
| Approach | (1) Add `eng/docs-only-test-classes.txt`: explicit allowlist, one exact test class name per line, comments allowed. (2) Add `[switch]$DocsOnlyTestSelection` to `eng/verify-release.ps1` (param block :1-7). Inside the existing `$TestShardCount -gt 1` block (:366-393) after the plan is read: when the switch is set, load the allowlist; throw if the file is missing, empty, or names a class absent from the discovered plan (fail closed to a loud error, not silent under-selection); when the switch is unset behavior is byte-identical. Selection: shard 0 runs the full allowlist as `(ClassName=A|ClassName=B)&$testFilter`; other shards log `Docs-only selection: allowlist runs on shard 0; nothing to run on shard N` and skip `dotnet test` and `Assert-TestResultFile` (an empty vstest match writes no TRX and would trip the assert). This avoids a zero-match shard by construction instead of intersecting per shard. Unclassifiable input (switch set with `TestShardCount -le 1`) ignores the switch and runs the full suite. (3) `ci.yml` verify step (:134-146): add `$parameters.DocsOnlyTestSelection = $true` only inside the existing `docs_only == true` condition, leaving the full-route parameters and matrix untouched. (4) Extend `CiTopologyDecisionContractTests` to pin the allowlist file contents (sorted, exact list), assert every listed class exists in the test assembly by reflection, assert `ci.yml` passes the switch only on the docs-only branch, and assert the dispatch/schedule and coverage paths never pass it. Mirror the existing text-contract assertions in that file. |
| Scope | 3 production files: `eng/verify-release.ps1`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `eng/docs-only-test-classes.txt` (new). 1 test file: `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/CiTopologyDecisionContractTests.cs`. One coherent change: one test-selection call site, its input file, its workflow wiring, and its contract test (structural-unit). Routing in `eng/resolve-ci-topology.ps1` is untouched. |
| Tool policy | edit-only |
| Estimated context cost | 45000 |
| Risks | Sequenced AFTER `actionlint-local-only-no-ci-gate` (edits ci.yml) and `verify-release-stale-package-cache-asset-graph` (edits verify-release.ps1); both files are hotspots, so rebase and re-read the anchors first. Allowlist membership is a judgment call (about two dozen documentation/CI-contract classes named in the detail file: `CiTopologyDecisionContractTests`, `PluginInstallDocumentationContractTests`, `ReleaseManagedFileGuardDocumentationTests`, `PublishWorkflowContractTests`, `ActionlintGateContractTests`, `CiRunnerParityContractTests`); executor must enumerate the rest by grepping tests for classes that read `ai_docs/`, `docs/`, `.github/`, `eng/` files. Under-selection is the main risk; mitigated by fail-closed throws and the full-suite dispatch/schedule path. Design deviation from the prior-attempt idea of intersecting the allowlist with each shard filter: a per-shard intersection can be empty, and an empty vstest match yields no TRX which `Assert-TestResultFile` rejects; hence shard-0-runs-all. Coverage re-measurement paths (`coverage-baseline-stale`) never pass the switch. Fanout probe (shape B: one call site plus wiring files): defining files are the 2 edited scripts/workflow plus the new allowlist and 1 test file; callers of verify-release.ps1 with the new optional switch need no edits because it defaults off. |
| Validation | `pwsh eng/verify-release.ps1 -Configuration Release -NoCoverage -ExcludeNetworkTests -TestShardIndex 0 -TestShardCount 2 -TestShardOnly -DocsOnlyTestSelection` runs only allowlist classes; same with `-TestShardIndex 1` skips cleanly with exit 0; a deliberately bogus allowlist entry throws. Run `dotnet test --filter ClassName=RoslynMcp.Tests.CiTopologyDecisionContractTests` (use the repo's fully qualified name form) and `eng/verify-actionlint.ps1` on ci.yml. |
| Performance review | N/A - CI test-selection change, no runtime hot-path changes. |
| CHANGELOG category | Changed |
| CHANGELOG entry (draft) | CI: the docs-only route now runs a declared documentation-contract test allowlist (`eng/docs-only-test-classes.txt`) instead of the full sharded suite, failing closed to the full suite on any unclassifiable input. |

### 5. verify-release-stale-package-cache-asset-graph

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | deepen |
| Diagnosis | The ambiguous-nuspec error is thrown by `eng/update-third-party-notices.ps1:132-134` (`Get-RestoredNuspecPath`). Its input `Get-RestoredAssetRecords` (`eng/update-third-party-notices.ps1:53-54`) globs EVERY `obj/project.assets.json` under RepoRoot, not just the graphs the current restore produced. `eng/verify-release.ps1:323` restores only `$solutionPath`, then `eng/verify-release.ps1:327-330` runs the validation with `RepoRoot` only. Assets files left by a prior `NUGET_PACKAGES` root (projects outside the solution, or stale trees) stay on disk with the old `packageFolders`. The same library key then resolves to two nuspec paths (`update-third-party-notices.ps1:117-127`) and the gate fails. |
| Approach | Scope the asset set to the active restore. Add an optional `-SolutionPath` param to `update-third-party-notices.ps1`. `Get-RestoredAssetRecords` keeps only assets whose `project.restore.projectPath` is a project of that solution, enumerated via `dotnet sln <sln> list` or the slnx XML. Additionally skip assets whose `packageFolders` do not include the active `NUGET_PACKAGES` root when set. `verify-release.ps1:330` passes `SolutionPath = $solutionPath` in Parameters. Without `-SolutionPath` behavior is unchanged, so existing callers stay compatible. Extend `ThirdPartyNoticeDriftTests` (existing nuspec-drift harness) with a fixture holding a stale extra assets file (foreign cache root, same library key) beside a current one, and assert no ambiguity error. `VerifyReleaseChildScriptTests` is at most touched for the parameter contract. |
| Scope | Production files (2): `eng/update-third-party-notices.ps1`, `eng/verify-release.ps1`. Test files (1-2): `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/ThirdPartyNoticeDriftTests.cs`, optionally `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/VerifyReleaseChildScriptTests.cs`. No deletions. Within the Rule 3 target. |
| Tool policy | edit-only |
| Estimated context cost | 35000 |
| Risks | `eng/verify-release.ps1` is also edited by sibling `docs-only-route-runs-full-test-suite`, so it lands BEFORE that row (which carries `dependsOn` on this one); no dependsOn edge here. The anchor `VerifyReleaseChildScriptTests.cs` is real, but the assets glob lives in `update-third-party-notices.ps1`, which the row does not name (not stale, just incomplete). Not fanout-shaped: only an optional parameter is added, so `fanoutEstimate` is null. Verify the `dotnet sln list` / slnx enumeration handles both `.sln` and `.slnx` (whichever `$solutionPath` is). Verify `-TestShardOnly` skips the step, so it is unaffected. |
| Validation | `pwsh` run of the new regression in `ThirdPartyNoticeDriftTests`. Run `just ci` (`ci_equivalent`) twice with different external `NUGET_PACKAGES` roots and no manual `obj` cleanup. Run the existing `VerifyReleaseChildScriptTests` and `ThirdPartyNoticeDriftTests`. |
| Performance review | N/A — correctness fix, no hot-path changes. |
| CHANGELOG category | Fixed |
| CHANGELOG entry (draft) | Release verification's third-party license check now reads only the current solution's restored asset graphs, so switching `NUGET_PACKAGES` roots no longer reports ambiguous nuspec paths. |
| Backlog sync | Close rows: [verify-release-stale-package-cache-asset-graph]. |
